budget.qualification: Predeclared lot3A cost correction: two fixed cohorts of four cold-knowledge sessions per case and version, ordered baseline1, after1, after2, baseline2. Each case in each cohort has one separate three-action warmup. Pool all eight measured sessions per case and version, retain every cohort result, and apply the unchanged 10% observed median bound. No measured-session exclusion, noise allowance or result-dependent follow-up.
